name: How long does a garage conversion typically take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage conversion typically take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most garage conversions take between four to eight weeks once work starts on-site. The overall schedule depends on whether the remodel is a simple dry room conversion or a full living suite. Adding bathrooms requires concrete trenching, plumbing rough-ins, and inspection phases before framing can close up. At HH Remodeling LLC, owner Abraham Becerra serves as the on-site lead, managing framing, drywall, painting, and finish carpentry while scheduling licensed trade partners for mechanical rough-ins to keep the schedule moving without unnecessary downtime between phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most garage conversions take 4 to 8 weeks, depending on whether plumbing, bathrooms, and sub-trade rough-ins are required.
